weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. At start of combat, if both unit's and foe's HP = 100% or if both unit's and foe's HP < 100%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of damage dealt to unit.
Boosts damage by 50% of damage dealt to unit.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+8 during combat.

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Def-1 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Def (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Def-2 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Def (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Def-3 on foe and neutralizes foe's bonuses to Atk/Def (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) during combat.
